journal_lines_cost_code_needs_project.name: journal_lines_cost_code_needs_project
journal_lines_cost_code_needs_project.value: "journal_lines"."cost_code_id" IS NULL OR "journal_lines"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

credit_notes_party_matches.name: credit_notes_party_matches
credit_notes_party_matches.value:
("credit_notes"."party" = 'customer' AND "credit_notes"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_notes"."vendor_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("credit_notes"."party" = 'vendor' AND "credit_notes"."vendor_id" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_notes"."customer_id" IS NULL)

credit_notes_document_matches.name: credit_notes_document_matches
credit_notes_document_matches.value:
("credit_notes"."party" = 'customer' AND "credit_notes"."bill_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("credit_notes"."party" = 'vendor' AND "credit_notes"."invoice_id" IS NULL)

fixed_assets_disposal_complete.name: fixed_assets_disposal_complete
fixed_assets_disposal_complete.value:
("fixed_assets"."status" = 'disposed') = ("fixed_assets"."disposed_on" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("fixed_assets"."disposed_on" IS NULL) = ("fixed_assets"."disposal_proceeds_cents" IS NULL)

action_tokens_purpose_shape.name: action_tokens_purpose_shape
action_tokens_purpose_shape.value:
("action_tokens"."purpose" = 'company_invitation') = ("action_tokens"."company_id" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("action_tokens"."purpose" = 'practice_invitation') = ("action_tokens"."practice_id" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("action_tokens"."purpose" <> 'password_reset' OR "action_tokens"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

communications_has_party.name: communications_has_party
communications_has_party.value: "communications"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL OR "communications"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL OR "communications"."opportunity_id" IS NOT NULL

work_order_entries_material_has_item.name: work_order_entries_material_has_item
work_order_entries_material_has_item.value:
("work_order_entries"."kind" = 'material' AND "work_order_entries"."item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "work_order_entries"."quantity_milli" > 0)
          OR ("work_order_entries"."kind" <> 'material' AND "work_order_entries"."item_id" IS NULL AND "work_order_entries"."quantity_milli" IS NULL)

appointments_completed_knows_its_split.name: appointments_completed_knows_its_split
appointments_completed_knows_its_split.value: "appointments"."status" <> 'completed' OR ("appointments"."practitioner_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "appointments"."completed_on" IS NOT NULL)
